title: hamster eating
author: Yuval
changes: Pet hamster nibbling and crunching its food at night, recorded close up with a shotgun microphone. Trimmed to 39.20–42.10 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass is applied because the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
